nodes.label: absent = retain stored, null = explicit clear, object = validate and store as draft
nodes.norm_label: absent = retain stored, null = explicit clear, object = validate and store as draft

nodes.label: 13 Bible findings, 5 high severity — fonts, type scale, palette, banned gradient, sub-44px targets
nodes.norm_label: 13 bible findings, 5 high severity — fonts, type scale, palette, banned gradient, sub-44px targets

nodes.label: A new Phase 0: the design system built byte-exact to the Bible, with a build gate, before the first screen exists
nodes.norm_label: a new phase 0: the design system built byte-exact to the bible, with a build gate, before the first screen exists

nodes.label: The Bible wins; the skill informs choices within the Bible's constraints
nodes.source_file: docs/brain/60-Decisions/0007 Design system inputs and conflict resolution.md
nodes.norm_label: the bible wins; the skill informs choices within the bible's constraints

nodes.label: The accent ramp is derived at runtime in OKLab from a single --accent; accent-fg computed in JS against 4.5:1
nodes.source_file: docs/brain/60-Decisions/0007 Design system inputs and conflict resolution.md
nodes.rationale: A user-picked custom accent gets the same 10-step ramp as the built-in packs, because CSS cannot yet compute contrast portably.
nodes.norm_label: the accent ramp is derived at runtime in oklab from a single --accent; accent-fg computed in js against 4.5:1

nodes.label: Self-hosted Space Grotesk + Inter, not the Google Fonts CDN
nodes.source_file: docs/brain/60-Decisions/0007 Design system inputs and conflict resolution.md
nodes.rationale: The strict CSP forbids third-party style and font origins.
nodes.norm_label: self-hosted space grotesk + inter, not the google fonts cdn

nodes.label: Decisions index (ADR MOC)
nodes.rationale: One note per decision that future phases must not re-litigate; the dataview lists only notes whose type is `adr`.

nodes.label: Defects found by measurement, not by reading
nodes.rationale: Nine defects were invisible to code review and only a running check caught them — fonts not loading, tree-shaken tokens, a self-referential token, a vacuous guard, a 24px hit area, oversized rows, mislabelled translations, boot-only migrations, and Piscina swallowing SQLite error messages.
nodes.norm_label: defects found by measurement, not by reading

nodes.label: ADR-0001 — Numbered migrations via PRAGMA user_version
nodes.source_file: docs/brain/60-Decisions/0001 Numbered migrations via PRAGMA user_version.md
nodes.rationale: Executing schema.sql at boot is fine for a greenfield scaffold and wrong the moment a live DB must evolve.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001 — numbered migrations via pragma user_version

nodes.label: ADR-0003 — CSP hash allowlist for vendor-injected styles
nodes.source_file: docs/brain/60-Decisions/0003 CSP hash allowlist for vendor styles.md
nodes.rationale: sonner and vaul inject stylesheets at module scope with no opt-out, so under style-src 'self' both rendered unstyled in production — invisible in dev, because Vite serves the shell without helmet.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0003 — csp hash allowlist for vendor-injected styles

nodes.label: The server fails closed on a missing or malformed manifest

nodes.norm_label: the server fails closed on a missing or malformed manifest

nodes.label: ADR-0004 — Tri-state custom-theme config retention
nodes.rationale: Requiring custom iff theme='custom' destroyed saved builder work when a user merely explored a pack.

nodes.label: ADR-0006 — Full rebuild from scratch
nodes.rationale: The backend was genuinely solid, but the design layer was wrong at its foundation; patching fonts, type scale, palette and touch targets under finished screens means re-laying out every screen anyway.

nodes.label: ADR-0007 — Design system inputs and conflict resolution
nodes.source_file: docs/brain/60-Decisions/0007 Design system inputs and conflict resolution.md
nodes.rationale: Two authorities feed the token layer and the conflict rule is explicit: the Bible always wins, the skill informs choices within its constraints.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0007 — design system inputs and conflict resolution

nodes.label: The three rejections recorded so a future session does not re-apply them
nodes.source_file: docs/brain/60-Decisions/0007 Design system inputs and conflict resolution.md
nodes.rationale: Palette, typography and the B2B landing-page pattern were rejected; recording the rejection is what stops a later session helpfully undoing it.
nodes.norm_label: the three rejections recorded so a future session does not re-apply them

nodes.label: Neon's stack stays at zero offset and Mono's stays none
nodes.rationale: A glow that gains a y-offset is a drop shadow, and Mono separates by its edge; the three-layer stack is a construction, not a licence to give every pack the same shadow.
nodes.norm_label: neon's stack stays at zero offset and mono's stays none

nodes.label: Never moralise about the body
nodes.rationale: No praise for a low number and no green for a falling weight; the app reports and the user decides what it means. The one voice rule that is also a color rule.

nodes.label: --noise-overlay: a 3% feTurbulence grain
nodes.rationale: A two-stop gradient over ~400px asks for ~200 steps of one hue and a 6-bit phone panel has 64, so it bands; the grain dithers the band edges. Inline, so it costs no request and the CSP needs no image origin.

nodes.label: --on-accent-subtle, never text-accent on the accent wash
nodes.rationale: The wash IS the accent at 20%, so accent-on-wash can never open a contrast gap in any pack at any hue; measured 4.82/4.42/4.08/3.67 against the app's own 4.5, while the ink measures 11.70 down to 9.03.
nodes.norm_label: --on-accent-subtle, never text-accent on the accent wash

nodes.label: Exactly one accent, plus a ramp interpolated in OKLab
nodes.rationale: One accent means 'accent' always reads as 'act here'; OKLab interpolation gives a user's custom accent the same perceptual spacing as the five built-in packs, and interaction states derive from the ramp instead of being hand-picked per component.
nodes.norm_label: exactly one accent, plus a ramp interpolated in oklab

nodes.label: Exactly one primary action per screen
nodes.rationale: Primary is the only variant with a filled accent background; two primaries on a screen means neither is.
nodes.norm_label: exactly one primary action per screen

nodes.label: Each pack's structural identity is deliberate, not decoration
nodes.rationale: Midnight calm, Solar soft, Neon pill-and-glow, Mono sharp-and-flat; flattening these into one look destroys the theme system.
nodes.norm_label: each pack's structural identity is deliberate, not decoration

nodes.label: The :root copy of Midnight is the pre-paint fallback
nodes.rationale: It guards against an unstyled flash on a cold, storage-less boot.
nodes.norm_label: the :root copy of midnight is the pre-paint fallback

nodes.label: Pressable — the single interactive primitive
nodes.rationale: Raw button is rejected outside src/ui/, so there is no second path; type defaults to 'button' because an unspecified button inside a form submits it.

nodes.label: Components never name a raw radius step
nodes.rationale: Five semantic aliases that every pack re-declares, so Mono can be square and Neon a pill without touching a component. The gate does not catch a raw step; a human has to.
nodes.norm_label: components never name a raw radius step

nodes.label: --radius-inset is derived, never tabulated
nodes.rationale: max(0px, radius-card - card-pad) keeps a nested surface concentric with its card through a pack swap and through a change to either input; a constant gap is what the eye reads as 'inside', two equal radii read as two overlapping cards.

nodes.label: Reduced motion collapses durations, it does not remove the state change
nodes.rationale: The change still happens and is still visible, it just does not travel; components additionally branch on the preference so they can skip transform-based motion entirely.
nodes.norm_label: reduced motion collapses durations, it does not remove the state change

nodes.label: Rule 0 — extract before inventing
nodes.rationale: If a value exists here it is already a decision, and changing it silently discards the reasoning that produced it.

nodes.label: Two scrim tokens
nodes.rationale: They were five raw bg-black/50|65 call sites the gate could not see because black is not in its palette list, so the app carried raw values while the gate printed clean. Two weights because a dialog you can see the page behind and a sheet that owns the screen are a real distinction.

nodes.label: Seven gates run on npm run build
nodes.rationale: check-tokens, check-i18n (777 keys x hu/en/de), check-interval, check-elements, check-autosave, check-safe-area and verify:outbox, plus tsc -b with noUnusedLocals.
nodes.norm_label: seven gates run on npm run build

nodes.label: --spacing IS the scale
nodes.rationale: A parallel spacing scale would give the app two sources of truth; spacing is also the only axis with no gate, because the rule inspects arbitrary values only, which is the structural reason it drifted.

nodes.label: Surfaces are elevation, never new colors
nodes.rationale: Four steps — page, card, inset, overlay — cover every stacking relationship the product has; a fifth surface would have to answer 'higher than what'. Never pure black, which smears on OLED.
nodes.norm_label: surfaces are elevation, never new colors

nodes.label: --table-max-h exists so the sticky header has a scroll container
nodes.rationale: A sticky header sticks to its nearest scrolling ancestor and an unconstrained wrapper never scrolls; the admin queue's sticky thead had never stuck once.
nodes.norm_label: --table-max-h exists so the sticky header has a scroll container

nodes.label: Tabular numerals on anything that counts
nodes.rationale: Timers, weights, reps, balances and counters never jitter width while changing.
nodes.norm_label: tabular numerals on anything that counts

nodes.label: --text-timer is 48px and not more
nodes.rationale: A lock-screen-clock size, legible from the floor at arm's length because the phone is not in the lifter's hand; not larger, because the player's hero is 193px tall at 375px wide and must fit five things.

nodes.rationale: coin_purchases keeps sku_snapshot/title_snapshot/price_minor_snapshot so a later catalogue edit cannot rewrite history; conversations keeps coach_name_snapshot and content_reports keeps body_snapshot for the same reason

nodes.label: Schema conventions that hold everywhere
nodes.rationale: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY id; created_at/updated_at as unix epoch seconds; enums as CHECK constraints but a lookup TABLE wherever an admin must edit the set; junction tables for every m:n relation, never a JSON list; JSON columns only for non-relational config blobs; every client-owned row carries an owner column with a composite index

nodes.label: @theme inline for the color mapping
nodes.rationale: The var resolves at use time, so a [data-theme] swap repaints the whole app without a single component re-render.

nodes.label: A token without a WHY is a preference, not a decision
nodes.rationale: If you add a token and cannot write its reason in one line, it does not go in.
nodes.norm_label: a token without a why is a preference, not a decision

nodes.label: TRACKER Design System
nodes.rationale: Extracted from the code rather than invented for it: 172 token names across 277 declaration sites, collected with the reasons that produced them so the next person does not clean up a decision.

nodes.label: Two elevations, each a three-layer stack
nodes.rationale: A single drop shadow gives one distance cue, so the sheet, the floating rest timer and the command palette all floated at the same apparent height; contact + mid + ambient sums to the same weight while giving three. Still no open scale.
nodes.norm_label: two elevations, each a three-layer stack

nodes.label: Nine type steps, each carrying its own line-height, weight and tracking
nodes.rationale: Tailwind 4 attaches all four properties to the utility so a step is complete on its own; 11px micro is the floor and its 0.06em tracking is the reason the step exists, so never pair it with a hand-written tracking-wide.
nodes.norm_label: nine type steps, each carrying its own line-height, weight and tracking

nodes.label: Address the user directly, informally, second person singular
nodes.rationale: This is a training app used mid-effort: formal address would make the app a clerk, and the product is closer to a training partner.
nodes.norm_label: address the user directly, informally, second person singular

nodes.label: --z-sticky sits below --z-nav on purpose
nodes.rationale: A table header scrolling over the bottom navigation is a header covering the way out of the screen.

nodes.label: A custom accent is written straight onto the root element
nodes.rationale: It overrides the pack's own value and every derived token recomputes from it; both the pack name and the hex are validated before use, and a corrupt cache must never stop the app from rendering.
nodes.norm_label: a custom accent is written straight onto the root element

nodes.label: apple-touch-icon
nodes.rationale: iOS ignores the manifest's icons entirely and reads this one.

nodes.label: The inline script is allowed by its sha256 hash
nodes.rationale: Under the production CSP there is no unsafe-inline, so a build script derives the hash from the built file.
nodes.norm_label: the inline script is allowed by its sha256 hash

nodes.rationale: Food catalogue backing nutrition logging and FTS food search

nodes.label: message_reports table
nodes.rationale: status is open/upheld/rejected with a partial CHECK tying the open state to the resolution fields; resolved_by is ON DELETE SET NULL and body_snapshot preserves the reported text even after the message is deleted.

nodes.label: nutrition_log_items table
nodes.source_location: 16 columns, per-client daily food log with denormalized macro snapshots

nodes.label: nutrition_plan_days table
nodes.source_location: 11 columns, one row per day_index of a nutrition plan cycle with macro targets

nodes.source_location: 18 columns, scoped (template/client/personal/system) versioned nutrition plan header

nodes.label: Snapshot denormalization of referenced rows
nodes.rationale: meal_items copies food_name and every macro into *_snapshot columns while food_id is ON DELETE SET NULL, so a saved plan keeps the numbers it was built from even if the food row is later edited or deleted. message_reports.body_snapshot preserves reported text the same way.

nodes.label: The favicon link that nothing referenced before
nodes.rationale: public/favicon.svg had shipped since Phase 1 with no link element, so every browser fell back to requesting /favicon.ico, got the SPA's index.html, and drew its default page glyph.
nodes.norm_label: the favicon link that nothing referenced before

nodes.label: index.html — the app shell document
nodes.rationale: Hungarian-language shell carrying the pre-paint theme script, the icon links and the viewport and color-scheme meta the rest of the design system depends on.

nodes.label: Pre-paint theme application
nodes.rationale: Runs before the stylesheet and before React, which is the only way to avoid a flash of the default theme for a user who picked another; deliberately tiny, synchronous and dependency-free, with the whole body wrapped because anything that throws would leave the page unstyled.

nodes.label: theme-color matches surface-0 of the default pack
nodes.rationale: So the browser chrome and the overscroll area do not flash a lighter color before the stylesheet lands.
nodes.norm_label: theme-color matches surface-0 of the default pack

nodes.label: B10 — the y axis is min-max normalized and never labelled
nodes.rationale: Every series fills the full drawing height regardless of its range, so a bodyweight series of 80.0 to 80.4 kg is a full-height climb in a fitness app, to a user reading their own body; preserveAspectRatio=none also renders the same data at two different slopes.
nodes.norm_label: b10 — the y axis is min-max normalized and never labelled

nodes.label: B16 — not one exit-specific transition in the codebase
nodes.rationale: Dismissing costs exactly as long as opening, an underdamped spring settles past the entrance cap, and three disclosure panels mount with no transition so content below jumps under the thumb. The curve set itself is satisfied and must not be touched.
nodes.norm_label: b16 — not one exit-specific transition in the codebase

nodes.label: B1 — two finished features are unreachable on a phone
nodes.rationale: Progress and coins have no in-app link; their sole entry point is the command palette, which is hidden below 1024px in a mobile-first product. The bottom nav is at its five-slot cap, so this is a real IA choice.
nodes.norm_label: b1 — two finished features are unreachable on a phone

nodes.label: B24 — there is no Card component and layer 3 has no consumers
nodes.rationale: Eight component-layer aliases have zero hits across 84 files while the card is written out at 171 call sites, so editing the layer the docs point at cascades to nothing; clickable cards on the public browsing surface consequently have no hover at all. Either extract the primitive or delete the dead aliases — not both.
nodes.norm_label: b24 — there is no card component and layer 3 has no consumers

nodes.label: B25 — the gate reports clean while values sit outside the layer
nodes.rationale: It prints 'no raw values outside the token layer' while six are; extend it to scan JS style strings and include black and white, and land the token additions first so the new rule does not block the repo.
nodes.norm_label: b25 — the gate reports clean while values sit outside the layer

nodes.label: B27 — the overlay type is chosen by a global style setting, not by intent
nodes.rationale: Whether a surface is a blocking dialog depends on the admin's element-style pack, so an informational invite-code display and a destructive archive confirm get identical modal semantics.
nodes.norm_label: b27 — the overlay type is chosen by a global style setting, not by intent

nodes.label: Coach-side chat lives in the Chat tab of the client detail screen
nodes.rationale: A coach's chat is always about a client, so reaching it through the client is the shorter path and it inherits the link's ownership predicate for free.
nodes.norm_label: coach-side chat lives in the chat tab of the client detail screen

nodes.label: OWN_OR_HELD in ics.js — who may see and revoke a calendar feed
nodes.norm_label: own_or_held in ics.js — who may see and revoke a calendar feed

nodes.label: A round is a set row
nodes.rationale: Making a round a ROW gives idempotency, an order-independent offline queue and crash resume for free, with zero new server code.
nodes.norm_label: a round is a set row

nodes.label: The schedule rule and calendar day collapsed into backend/src/plans/schedule.js
nodes.rationale: It was declared collapsed while the ICS generator still carried a copy that had already drifted twice.
nodes.norm_label: the schedule rule and calendar day collapsed into backend/src/plans/schedule.js

nodes.label: MEMBER_OF (chat) — a security predicate written once
nodes.rationale: A security predicate with two copies has one that is wrong.
nodes.norm_label: member_of (chat) — a security predicate written once

nodes.label: API surface — 171 endpoints
nodes.rationale: Generated from the LIVE schema and the mounted routers by brain-gen.mjs, never hand-edited, so the guard column cannot claim a protection the code does not have.

nodes.label: Phase 2 lessons — the durable half
nodes.rationale: The cold half of SHARED_MEMORY: the lessons that outlive the phase, written so a reader who has never seen the hot file gets the whole point.

nodes.label: A failed send says so, and stays
nodes.rationale: A vanished message reads as a sent message.
nodes.norm_label: a failed send says so, and stays

nodes.label: Derive everything from one anchor
nodes.rationale: Three separate interval defects were the same mistake — a value derived from something else. The interruption rule has no time threshold; the honest discriminator is whether a segment was ever announced.

nodes.label: The one recurring bug class: two things that must agree, drifting apart
nodes.rationale: The fix is never 'fix both' — it is collapsing to ONE definition. Declaring a duplicate gone is not the same as deleting it.
nodes.norm_label: the one recurring bug class: two things that must agree, drifting apart

nodes.label: Flag, do not filter — and never invent a duration
nodes.rationale: An option that vanishes teaches a coach nothing; a block whose durations were never written is runnable:false and says so.
nodes.norm_label: flag, do not filter — and never invent a duration

nodes.label: Idempotency: put the state in the WHERE clause
nodes.rationale: A replay should report zero changes, not raise; void is guarded on voided_at IS NULL and finish on status='in_progress', which turns a raised trigger into an honest 404.
nodes.norm_label: idempotency: put the state in the where clause

nodes.label: Do not re-implement what the schema already owns
nodes.rationale: The void transaction recomputes no rollups because a trigger rebuilds them; and within a day a record is a high-water mark, not a stack, so voiding one does not restore the previous.
nodes.norm_label: do not re-implement what the schema already owns

nodes.label: Widening a permission is three changes, not one
nodes.rationale: Widening who can CREATE a thing is not done until who can SEE and DESTROY it widens with it.
nodes.norm_label: widening a permission is three changes, not one

nodes.label: The failure path is the one nobody walks
nodes.rationale: SetRow.submit had try/finally and no catch, so a lifter could not tell a recorded set from a lost one; and offering a control that cannot succeed is worse than offering none. A feature is finished when every screen displaying the affected row agrees with the new state.
nodes.norm_label: the failure path is the one nobody walks

nodes.label: B2 — six deletes with no confirm, no undo and silent failure
nodes.rationale: Including a progress photo and a whole training day cascading its blocks; the verb lives in an aria-label where no sighted user reads it, and the friction mechanism already exists in the repo as the set-row hold gesture.
nodes.norm_label: b2 — six deletes with no confirm, no undo and silent failure

nodes.label: B33 — critical errors auto-dismiss in 4 seconds
nodes.rationale: The one channel that reports whether a save landed erases its own error before a user who looked away can read it; hover-pause restarts rather than resumes, and overflow past three is dropped rather than queued.
nodes.norm_label: b33 — critical errors auto-dismiss in 4 seconds

nodes.label: B36 — shipped library code that deletes on a thumb-drag
nodes.rationale: A full swipe fires delete instantly with no revealed button, no undo and no keyboard fallback, and the catalog advertises a long-press variant the component does not implement. Its only call site today is the admin QA screen — a trap for the first team that wires it to real data.
nodes.norm_label: b36 — shipped library code that deletes on a thumb-drag

nodes.label: B3 — writes fail silently across the product
nodes.rationale: The toast host is reached by exactly two files, one submit awaits a mutation with no try/catch, the query client retries 5xx twice with nothing consuming the terminal failure, and there is no error boundary anywhere, so a render throw is a white screen.
nodes.norm_label: b3 — writes fail silently across the product

nodes.label: B4 — offline edits are not queued and the post editor debounces at 1500ms
nodes.rationale: The app has an outbox whose only producer is the workout hook, so a post edited on a dead connection goes to failed and the text lives only in React state. The single-flight and never-claim-Saved-for-unreceived-content behaviour must be protected while fixing it.
nodes.norm_label: b4 — offline edits are not queued and the post editor debounces at 1500ms

nodes.label: B5 — a server outage renders as 'you have nothing'
nodes.rationale: No list screen has an error branch, so a 500 leaves data undefined and renders 'no results' for a search that never ran; six detail routes merge error into not-found, telling an offline user the coach's profile was taken down.
nodes.norm_label: b5 — a server outage renders as 'you have nothing'

nodes.label: B6 — busy produces nothing perceptible on touch
nodes.rationale: The whole busy affordance is a cursor state in a mobile-first app; the fix belongs inside the primitive so no call site has to remember it, and the gate that rejects raw buttons means one edit reaches every button.
nodes.norm_label: b6 — busy produces nothing perceptible on touch

nodes.label: B7 — busy maps onto native disabled, and one in-flight check freezes a list
nodes.rationale: The native attribute drops the button out of the tab order and the browser blurs it, while the style layer is written as though busy were still focusable; a pending flag passed to every set row costs a lifter their caret mid-entry.
nodes.norm_label: b7 — busy maps onto native disabled, and one in-flight check freezes a list

nodes.label: B8 — no skip link, and modals do not trap Tab
nodes.rationale: Tab walks out of an aria-modal dialog onto the page behind it, including the row the archive dialog is confirming about; the command palette already does the focus restore correctly, so the fix exists in the codebase.
nodes.norm_label: b8 — no skip link, and modals do not trap tab

nodes.label: B9 — the auth screen validates on submit and says 'the operation failed'
nodes.rationale: The same generic string renders under both fields, the 12-char rule shown in the hint is enforced server-side only, and two Progress surfaces map every error to one specific message — telling a user with a dropped connection that their measurement is implausible.
nodes.norm_label: b9 — the auth screen validates on submit and says 'the operation failed'

nodes.rationale: Nothing in shapes.ts carries its own coordinates, so a muscle cannot sit in the wrong place.
nodes.norm_label: landmarks.ts — the skeleton (8-head canon, half-widths, separate arm and leg axes)

nodes.label: mirror() — symmetry is arithmetic, not typing
nodes.rationale: It throws on a relative command, because a mirror quietly off by one segment is invisible until someone looks at a rendered body and says it is skewed.
nodes.norm_label: mirror() — symmetry is arithmetic, not typing

nodes.norm_label: muscle map — a hand-built svg figure

nodes.label: Point-sampling overlap check
nodes.rationale: Bounding boxes report overlaps that are not there and miss ones that are; sampling points confirmed inside A and asking B gives a true percentage. Threshold worth acting on is ~12%.

nodes.norm_label: pressable — one primitive owning the 44px floor, the five states, the token contract and the busy state

nodes.label: The external-memory law
nodes.rationale: The superseded report claimed 1648 seeded exercises and 20 endpoints that existed nowhere — a memory describing absent code is exactly the failure mode the law exists to prevent.

nodes.label: A gated page is the one nobody walks
nodes.rationale: /admin for a non-admin and /coach for a non-coach rendered only an EmptyState, whose h2 left those pages with no h1 — which is why the walk had to run in BOTH roles.
nodes.norm_label: a gated page is the one nobody walks

nodes.label: What the phase report cannot claim
nodes.rationale: Real-device rendering and actual screen-reader behaviour are asserted structurally, not observed, and are named in the Phase-2 Bible audit rather than quietly folded into a pass.
nodes.norm_label: what the phase report cannot claim

nodes.label: State that carries information is never animation-dependent
nodes.rationale: A highlight or a count must be correct even when no animation frame ever runs.
nodes.norm_label: state that carries information is never animation-dependent

nodes.label: A batch edit that reports success without reporting WHICH replacements landed will lie to you
nodes.rationale: A sed pass silently matched nothing, so an overlap went 13% to 16% and looked like the fix had made things worse.
nodes.norm_label: a batch edit that reports success without reporting which replacements landed will lie to you

nodes.label: Why it is hand-built and not a licensed or traced asset
nodes.rationale: A bitmap cannot take a per-muscle fill from a theme token, cannot be addressed one slug at a time, and an anatomy plate of unknown provenance has no place in a bundle whose one third-party dataset is carefully attributed.
nodes.norm_label: why it is hand-built and not a licensed or traced asset

nodes.label: The 44 px exception, stated so it is not 'fixed' later
nodes.rationale: Twelve anatomically placed regions cannot each be 44 px without a metre-tall figure, so the map is a SECONDARY affordance and never the only path; if it ever becomes the only way to pick a muscle, the fix is to restore the chip row.
nodes.norm_label: the 44 px exception, stated so it is not 'fixed' later

nodes.label: Overlap between different slugs is a functional bug, not a cosmetic one
nodes.rationale: A click in shared pixels selects whichever was painted last: the user gets the wrong muscle and nothing indicates it.
nodes.norm_label: overlap between different slugs is a functional bug, not a cosmetic one

nodes.label: The Obsidian vault mirror is the proven disaster-recovery path for project memory
nodes.rationale: The brain survived the deletion only because the mirror is a separate directory.
nodes.norm_label: the obsidian vault mirror is the proven disaster-recovery path for project memory

nodes.label: ADR-0011 — Animate UI not installed; components hand-built on Pressable
nodes.rationale: A vendored component set moves enforcement from the build back into somebody's memory, which is the failure mode this project spent two phases eliminating.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0011 — animate ui not installed; components hand-built on pressable

nodes.label: check-tokens collected declarations with a line-anchored regex and could not see four of its own tokens
nodes.rationale: That is how a gate stops being a guard and starts being an obstacle people route around.
nodes.norm_label: check-tokens collected declarations with a line-anchored regex and could not see four of its own tokens

nodes.label: bottom-sheets — UNCHECKED
nodes.rationale: Not assigned to any of the six passes, and not N/A by default — the app ships a Sheet with two live call sites. Recorded as a visible coverage gap rather than absorbed into a total, with two adjacent findings that touch the same component.

nodes.label: golden-ratio is VIOLATED and must not be actioned
nodes.rationale: The literal 1.618 is absent but the failure the rule prevents is not present — a documented 4px grid with a red-building gate. Re-deriving 172 tokens to satisfy a number is negative work.
nodes.norm_label: golden-ratio is violated and must not be actioned

nodes.label: Nine NOT APPLICABLE patterns, each with the surface that would trigger it
nodes.rationale: Input masking, OTP, inline editing, live cursors, star rating, drag-and-drop, bulk actions, context menu and landing-page skeleton, each naming the surface that would make it apply so the verdict can be revisited rather than re-derived.
nodes.norm_label: nine not applicable patterns, each with the surface that would trigger it

nodes.label: PATTERN-GAP
nodes.rationale: One work list consolidated from six independent read-only audit passes over 73 UX patterns; every verdict carries the citation the audit produced, and where an audit could not cite it is UNCHECKED rather than padded into a verdict.

nodes.label: Four root causes close several rows each
nodes.rationale: Single-layer shadow tokens, the absent Card component, the richer variant that ships only to the playground, and useToast being imported by two files in the whole product.
nodes.norm_label: four root causes close several rows each

nodes.label: V10 — three filled primaries on the landing screen
nodes.rationale: The recipe states 'exactly one primary action per screen' and the call sites break it: a primary per untrained row plus a second inside the hero card.
nodes.norm_label: v10 — three filled primaries on the landing screen

nodes.label: V16 — nested cards are not concentric
nodes.rationale: Outer radius 16 with 16px padding means the inner should be 0 and it is 16; nothing in the codebase computed outer minus padding.
nodes.norm_label: v16 — nested cards are not concentric

nodes.label: V1 — the contrast warning asserts the opposite of what it means
nodes.rationale: The accent picker renders the passing string whenever the value is valid, regardless of whether it passes, so a failing colour reads 'Contrast: 2.10:1 — clears the 4.5:1 minimum' in red beside a warning icon.
nodes.norm_label: v1 — the contrast warning asserts the opposite of what it means

nodes.label: V21 — accents ship fully saturated
nodes.rationale: Measured S=95/96/60/100% with no code desaturating an accent, while the token file itself notes the app's actual environment is an OLED phone.

nodes.label: V22 — the brand gradient has no noise layer
nodes.rationale: The gradient is well-formed — one accent, ~0 degrees of hue travel, monotonic lightness — but a grep for noise, grain or feTurbulence returns only prose, so it bands visibly on 6-bit panels.
nodes.norm_label: v22 — the brand gradient has no noise layer

nodes.label: V23 — four scrims and two durations outside the token layer
nodes.rationale: Raw durations inside JS style strings are invisible to a gate that only inspects Tailwind class syntax, and black is absent from its palette list.
nodes.norm_label: v23 — four scrims and two durations outside the token layer

nodes.label: V24 — card padding, border alpha and radius below the rule's figures
nodes.rationale: Three token values move all 171 rounded-card sites at once, which is both the point of the token and the risk; the 'two shadows on a card' clause is a documented counter-decision and must be re-litigated as a decision, not patched blind.
nodes.norm_label: v24 — card padding, border alpha and radius below the rule's figures

nodes.label: V5 — accent badges measure 4.42:1 at 11px
nodes.rationale: text-accent on bg-accent-subtle measured 4.82/4.42/4.08/3.67 over the four surfaces against the app's own 4.5 constant; the fix is the ink or a dedicated on-* token.

nodes.label: V6 — the destructive button sits in the primary-confirm slot
nodes.rationale: The danger Archive button is the first child of the flex row and Cancel is second; the label and the trigger position are already correct and should be left alone.
nodes.norm_label: v6 — the destructive button sits in the primary-confirm slot

nodes.label: V7 — the personal-record message is sr-only
nodes.rationale: A sighted lifter gets a yellow flash, a trophy, haptics and speech, and no text saying what was beaten; the string, the timer and the record data all already exist.
nodes.norm_label: v7 — the personal-record message is sr-only

nodes.label: V8 — every shadow in the app is a single layer
nodes.rationale: DESIGN.md:204 stated it outright ('there is no shadow scale'), and sheets, the floating rest timer and the command palette all float at identical apparent height. Token file only — every consumer already reads the token.
nodes.norm_label: v8 — every shadow in the app is a single layer

nodes.label: V9 — the focus ring and the active tab are the same colour
nodes.rationale: --focus-ring is the accent and the active tab is accent-filled, so 'which tab am I on' and 'which tab is focused' read as one signal; a distinct hue per pack must be contrast-verified on all five.
nodes.norm_label: v9 — the focus ring and the active tab are the same colour
